title: Loud But Resolved
issue: The ending defuses the conflict with laughter, a hug and cheers, leaving no open question.
fix: Mia's laugh dies. She turns to Ryan: "Then who is she? Because you still lied about the affair."
last_line: They hug. The sister pops champagne. Everyone cheers.

title: Quiet But Ominous
issue: The quiet lullaby opening has no conflict or stakes in its first 15 seconds.
fix: The man's voice stops singing and whispers through the monitor: "Mia... you're not alone in here."
last_line: A man's voice through the monitor, softly singing the same lullaby.

title: Cliffhanger In The Middle
issue: Ryan tears up the DNA proof and goes home to cook, so the reveal is defused.
fix: Ryan slips one torn half into his pocket. RYAN: Let's go home. Mia can't find out about these.
last_line: RYAN: Let's go home. I'll cook tonight.

title: Decision Ending
issue: The ending withholds which ticket she keeps, so the choice pays off nothing visible and reads as a tease.
fix: Mia tears one ticket in half. The final boarding call repeats, and she freezes, still holding the other.

title: Generic Open
issue: The generic small-talk opening gives no stakes until the drive reveal at the very end.
fix: Mia reaches for it. A hand slams down on the drive. Ryan's father looks straight at her and doesn't blink.
last_line: Mia reaches for it. A hand slams down on the drive. Ryan's father.

title: Sad But Closed
issue: The truth is accepted and they walk off hand in hand, leaving nothing unresolved.
fix: Mia walks away, then stops: "If it was an accident, why would Ryan's father hide the drive?"
last_line: They walk away hand in hand as the sun breaks through.
